issues.claim: Barbershops and hair salons are entirely absent from a Group C/D list that otherwise includes personal services (cleaning, pet grooming, dry cleaning, laundromats)

Searches also returned Reny's Hair Salon (91 Jackson), M J Hair Salon (44 Main), Trendz Hair & Nail (1 Ferry) and La Femme Spa Salon (95 Whitehead). Either the mapper skipped a whole personal-care category, or salons sit in a group outside this zone.
issues.fix: Confirm whether barber/salon belongs to group D. If it does, add the four NJTGO-confirmed shops at minimum; if it belongs to another group, state that explicitly in the file so the omission is not read as a gap.

issues.problem: A&Q Laundry Room (56 Jackson St, South River) is listed on the NJTGO South River page but is not in the list, even though three other laundromats are.

issues.claim: Website column is left blank for several businesses that do have sites

issues.claim: Borderline excluded types still in the list
issues.problem: Millwood, Inc. (7 Brick Plant Rd), Trap Rock Industries (369 Whitehead Ave) and VIGO (9D Brick Plant Rd) are multi-site corporate operations rather than local owner-run businesses, and Silver Key Music School (8 Old Bridge Tpke) is a school-type business. None is a food, bank, worship, government or hospital listing, and the mapper argues each site-level operation is small, so I do not treat these as exclusion failures - but the chain/school question is a judgement call.
issues.fix: Orchestrator to decide whether site-level plants of larger companies and a private music school stay in scope; if not, drop those four rows.

issues.problem: 52 Maple St appears twice in the source data (Silverback Heating, and Hanco Service outside the list); 396 Whitehead Ave carries Mr Concrete, Custom Landscaping, Punjab Truck and Reldan Metals #402; 427 Whitehead Ave carries Park Roofing Unit 1, SPE Contracting and Value King #4. These look like shared industrial/multi-tenant addresses rather than duplicates, but the rows are worth a sanity check.
